properties.name: reflow2 explains what it is and how to run it before it explains what it believes
properties.statement: Someone arriving at reflow2 cold must learn, in plain language and before any philosophy, what it physically is and how it runs on their machine: a binary they run locally, a design graph kept as a file in their own repository, and a coding agent that talks to it over MCP. They must then find where the agent instructions go and two or three concrete uses — starting a design from nothing, recovering one from a system that already exists, and asking what breaks if something changes. The doctrine that makes reflow2 worth using is not the entry point to it.
